stem: Which sentence provides the strongest evidence that Jim appreciates what his uncles are doing for him?

options.label: A
options.text: The boy cannot hit the baseball to his satisfaction.

options.label: B
options.text: The boy is arm-weary; he swings as hard as he is able.

options.label: C
options.text: "I hit it just about every time," the boy says.

options.label: D
options.text: He has never heard anything so beautiful.
